tools.name: analyze_site
tools.description: Fetches the public homepage of a website (no JavaScript, public addresses only) and returns its brand colours, fonts, platform (WordPress, WooCommerce, PrestaShop, Shoper, Shopify…), Google Tag Manager containers, consent tools already installed and detected trackers, plus suggested banner colours (

tools.name: recommend_plan
tools.description: Recommends the cheapest CookiePilot plan for the given monthly pageviews and number of domains, with current prices and limits of all plans, and a register link. monthly_pageviews is the traffic the user states for their site.

tools.name: get_install_snippet
tools.description: Step-by-step install instructions for a platform — HTML code (Consent Mode stub + banner script), the WordPress/WooCommerce plugin, the PrestaShop module, Google Tag Manager or Shoper. With a ready setup_token the code contains the real key of the account's domain; without it, YOUR_API_KEY is a plac

tools.name: create_account
tools.description: Starts a free CookiePilot sign-up for the user's own e-mail address and company, at the user's explicit request. CookiePilot e-mails a confirmation link to that address; no account exists until the address owner clicks it, sets a password and accepts the terms on CookiePilot's page. Returns a setup_

tools.name: check_account_status
tools.description: Returns pending_email (the user has not finished the confirmation page yet), ready (the account exists; the onboarding tools work with this setup_token for 24 hours) or expired.

tools.name: add_domain
tools.description: Adds the website to the confirmed account (setup_token must be ready). Defaults to the website given to create_account. An already added website is returned as is. The free plan includes one website.

tools.name: configure_banner
tools.description: Saves and publishes the banner look for a website on the confirmed account: colours (for example the suggested banner colours from a site analysis), position, layout, font and privacy policy URL. Returns a preview link to the CookiePilot panel.

tools.name: verify_installation
tools.description: Reports whether CookiePilot has seen its banner running on the website (verified) and, if not yet, whether the code is in the homepage HTML, with a hint for the user.

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Returns a Stripe Checkout link for the Pro or Business plan on the confirmed account, for a user who chose a paid plan. Payment happens only on Stripe's page; the tool takes no card details.

findings.detail: Description of "recommend_plan" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
